sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
prompt: Cinematic photograph of the same tiny ivory origami boat with one tall triangular sail sailing along a narrow clear path through long ivory paper strips on a dark wooden desk. The strips have opened into two clean banks, deep blue water between, warm amber light at the end of the path. A fragile idea finally finding a way through a mountain of work, photoreal tactile paper and water, strong readable leading lines, restrained film contrast, no text or screens.
